title: What is a Decision in Code?

slides.heading: What is a Decision in Code?
slides.body: What is a Decision in Code? is part of Conditional Execution. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: What is a Decision in Code?
slides.body: A decision in code lets a program choose what to do based on a condition. This makes programs responsive instead of fixed.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A decision is like a traffic light. The action depends on the signal: stop, wait, or go.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: A conditional needs a colon, correct indentation, and a condition that clearly evaluates to True or False.
